decisions.rationale: Tick-by-tick simulation couldn't handle extreme shift values; analytical approach is instant and always shows all phases

decisions.decision: Display width allocation: linear knob weight with no floor
decisions.rationale: knob*0.05 with sustain=0.02; zero knob = near-invisible phase, smooth continuous growth, no snap thresholds
Ensures envelope sits exactly on sustain reference line at center position
PS1 limits decay_shift to 4 bits but mid-knob produced only 155ms decay. Shift 20 makes decay proportional to attack. Engine handles >15 fine.

decisions.decision: Sampler drive is Q12 int32 gain with sat_s16 clipping
decisions.rationale: Independent overdrive for sampler voices, same +24dB range as input gain

decisions.decision: Trigger button has gate (default) and latch modes
decisions.rationale: Gate for modular-style hold behavior, latch for hands-free loop audition while adjusting markers

decisions.decision: Default ADSR: Rel=0, all Exp off
decisions.rationale: Clean flat rectangle at launch, transparent envelope until shaped

decisions.decision: ADPCM state cache built at sample load time
decisions.rationale: Correct decoder history at any position; prevents silence on marker jumps and short loops

decisions.decision: End-addr loop path keeps has_block=1 (matches VAG flag path)
decisions.rationale: Previous aggressive reset threw away decoded block, causing DC output on short loops

decisions.decision: Marker Lock freezes relative distances for window scanning
decisions.rationale: Enables scanning a fixed-size loop window across the sample
JUCE slider sensitivity APIs didn't work for rotary knobs; manual delta scaling preserves encoder feel while reducing marker travel proportional to zoom

decisions.decision: Block 0 silence is expected content, not engine bug
decisions.rationale: ADPCM decoder starts from zero history; first block of samples with lead-in silence decodes to zeros. Zoom/scroll resolves by letting user place markers on non-silent blocks.

next_action: MIDI verification with physical controller, or further zoom-knob tuning if feel still needs adjustment at extreme zoom levels
context_notes: Major sampler UX session. Fixed core loop engine bug (ADPCM state cache + end-addr loop path matching VAG flag behavior). Added latch/lock workflow for loop audition.
